name: code-project-guidance-map
description: Create signed AGENTS.md project indexes and manifest-backed guide trees for Codex project editing.

interface.shortDescription: Create signed AGENTS.md indexes and guide trees.
interface.longDescription: Builds and refreshes a marker-delimited AGENTS.md project index plus a signed manifest-backed Markdown guide tree under .agents/guidance-map/guides. AGENTS.md stays compact with editing rules, task routing, dependency rules, and a manifest digest; module internals live in lazy guide files whose content digests and source snapshots are recorded in .agents/guidance-map/manifest.json. Query validates selected guide digests before recommending them, and full verification can scan every guide. Lightweight hooks verify guidance freshness on session start, code-edit prompts, and task stop, adding bounded Codex context or an end-of-task system message when refresh is recommended. Ordinary threads request refreshes through the helper build command; the helper enforces one active script-coordinated Codex builder thread per repository, synchronizes later request context into that builder, and prevents multiple threads from constructing the same map concurrently. CLI users are launched through `codex exec`; Desktop-only users are handed off through a Desktop-created local project thread after the helper claims the same build lease.
defaultPrompt: Use $code-project-guidance-map to refresh the signed AGENTS.md guidance map via its single builder.
